title: Graphs and Algorithms
description: In this module you will have the opportunity to: prove mathematical properties of graphs; explore classical algorithms associated with graphs and trees; design algorithms for sorting and searching; apply various methods for determining the time complexity of algorithm; study the complexity classes P and NP and the concept of NP-completeness.
learning_objectives: Describe, and establish the correctness of, some of the fundamental algorithms in computing
Analyse the time complexity of an algorithm
Explain the complexity classes P and NP and the P=NP problem
Determine to which complexity class a computational problem belongs
topics: Algorithm analysis (time complexity, recurrence relations, Master Theorem)
The complexity classes P and NP, NP-completeness
